name: presence is permission
say: Here's the part that sounds impossible: there is no server. No account. No sign-up. Hypercomb runs entirely in your browser, and your content is stored on your own device, in the browser's private file system. Presence is permission — the data exists where you are. Publishing is optional and explicit: nothing leaves your machine until you decide to share it. And when you do share, it travels peer to peer over open relays — not into a company's database.
